verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs say apps are "organized yet modular thanks to Angular components and dependency injection," which directly matches the story. Community users corroborate reusable, encapsulated components and DI-aided testing. Criticism of the provider system's documentation and of global injector namespacing comes from older AngularJS-era threads and lowers confidence only. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the DI/injector and module system (only a marketing tagline is present), and current-era hands-on corroboration of DI specifically.
